projects.title: Japan PR Guide
projects.description: A bilingual English–Vietnamese HSP points calculator, permanent-residence route diagnosis, university bonus lookup, and route-specific evidence checklist for Japan.
projects.featuredDescription: Bilingual HSP scoring and permanent-residence planning for Japan.
projects.catalogDescription: Calculate HSP points and explore permanent-residence routes in Japan, in English or Vietnamese.

projects.title: JETRISE
projects.description: A browser airline-management game: build a fleet, open routes, plan weekly schedules, manage finances and optionally compete with AI airlines. Play in Vietnamese, English or Japanese, with local saves and backup/restore.
projects.featuredDescription: Run an airline with fleet and route planning, financial reports and optional AI competition. Available in Vietnamese, English and Japanese.
projects.catalogDescription: Build and run an airline: manage fleets, routes, weekly schedules and finances, with optional AI competition. Play in Vietnamese, English or Japanese and save progress on your device.

localizedDescriptions.vi: Game quản lý hãng hàng không trên trình duyệt: phát triển đội bay, mở tuyến, xếp lịch và theo dõi tài chính, với đối thủ AI tùy chọn. Hỗ trợ Việt, Anh, Nhật và lưu tiến trình trên thiết bị.
localizedDescriptions.ja: ブラウザーで遊べる航空会社経営ゲーム。機材・路線・運航スケジュール・財務を管理し、任意でAI他社との競争も楽しめます。ベトナム語・英語・日本語に対応し、進行状況は端末に保存されます。
localizedDescriptions.zh: 浏览器航空公司经营游戏：管理机队、航线、航班计划和财务，可选择与 AI 对手竞争。支持越南语、英语和日语，进度保存在本地。

projects.title: BizRoll
projects.description: A 2–4 player economic strategy board game with multiplayer rooms, AI opponents, auctions, market cycles, secret objectives, and Black Swan events.
projects.featuredDescription: A multiplayer economic strategy game shaped by auctions, AI opponents, market cycles, and Black Swan events.
projects.catalogDescription: Play an economic strategy board game with friends or AI opponents, auctions, and shifting markets.

projects.title: Neon Glider
projects.description: A lightweight Three.js endless runner through a neon tunnel. Dodge obstacles, collect energy, build a multiplier, and chase a longer run.
projects.featuredDescription: A fast neon tunnel run built with Three.js, energy pickups, obstacles, and persistent high scores.
projects.catalogDescription: Dodge obstacles and collect energy in a fast neon tunnel run built with Three.js.

projects.title: Macinity
projects.description: A native macOS workspace for monitoring, hardware sensors, files, applications, Wi-Fi/LAN and reviewed utility actions.
projects.featuredDescription: Your Mac. Everything connected: monitoring, diagnostics and everyday utilities.
projects.catalogDescription: Monitor your Mac, inspect hardware and networks, manage files and packages, and preview Work Profiles in one local-first workspace.

projects.title: RAGOps

projects.featuredDescription: Evaluation and release gates for production RAG and agent systems.
projects.catalogDescription: Compare RAG and agent releases, catch regressions, and inspect the evidence behind a release decision.

projects.title: Awesome Maintainer Defense

projects.featuredDescription: Offline, reversible security audits and defense profiles for open-source maintainers.
projects.catalogDescription: Review repository security, GitHub Actions, and moderation risks with an offline, reversible auditor.

projects.title: Proofline
projects.description: Local-first engineering decision memory for recovering why systems were built a certain way. It preserves immutable source versions and keeps every grounded answer traceable to exact source lines.
projects.featuredDescription: Traceable decision memory with immutable sources and exact citations.
projects.catalogDescription: Recover why a system was built a certain way, with answers linked to exact source lines.

projects.featuredDescription: Open-source local-first household finance for macOS, with reviewable reconciliation and source evidence.
projects.catalogDescription: Bring household finances into a local macOS ledger, with reconciliation and source evidence.
